basic_information.title: Warehouse Inventory and Supply Chain Management with Demand Prediction
basic_information.summary: An enterprise-grade inventory management system that uses machine learning to predict future product demand, optimizing stock levels and reducing warehouse holding costs.

abstract: Effective inventory management is a delicate balance between avoiding stockouts and minimizing holding costs. This project developed a comprehensive Warehouse Inventory and Supply Chain Management system integrated with a predictive analytics engine. Traditional systems rely on static reorder points, which fail to account for seasonality, trends, and external factors. This solution utilizes XGBoost and time-series models to forecast product demand by analyzing historical sales data, promotional schedules, and seasonal patterns. The platform provides warehouse managers with automated restocking alerts, dynamic safety stock calculations, and visual dashboards detailing inventory turnover rates. The implementation demonstrated a theoretical reduction in inventory holding costs by 15% while improving order fulfillment rates.
problem_statement: Static inventory reorder policies lead to overstocking of slow-moving items and stockouts of high-demand products, causing financial losses and reduced customer satisfaction in dynamic supply chains.

primary: Develop a centralized inventory tracking database for multiple warehouse locations.
Implement a machine learning model to forecast short-term and medium-term product demand.
Create a dashboard for visualizing stock levels, predictions, and operational metrics.
secondary: Automate the generation of purchase orders based on predictive thresholds.
Implement barcode scanning compatibility for warehouse floor operations.

included: Automated reorder point and safety stock calculation.
Supplier management and purchase order generation.
excluded: Real-time GPS tracking of delivery vehicles.
Direct integration with retail point-of-sale (POS) systems.
scope.deployment_context: Internal corporate web portal deployed on enterprise cloud infrastructure.

features.name: Real-time Inventory Tracking
features.description: Monitors stock levels, locations, and movements across multiple warehouses.

features.name: Predictive Demand Forecasting
features.description: Generates 30-day and 90-day sales forecasts for individual SKUs.

features.name: Automated Restocking Alerts
features.description: Notifies procurement when stock levels are predicted to fall below required safety margins.

features.name: Supplier Performance Tracking
features.description: Evaluates suppliers based on lead times and order fulfillment accuracy.

modules.purpose: Calculates future demand and optimal reorder metrics.
responsibilities: Execute ML models to generate forecasts.

frameworks.purpose: High-performance REST API for inventory operations.

database.purpose: Robust relational database for transaction and inventory integrity.

tools.purpose: Embedded analytics for advanced supply chain reporting.

ai_usage.description: Applies machine learning for time-series forecasting of product demand.
ai_usage.training_data: 3 years of anonymized corporate sales and inventory data.

algorithms.name: Economic Order Quantity (EOQ)
algorithms.purpose: Calculates the ideal order quantity to minimize holding and ordering costs.

reasons: Requires integration of complex business logic with predictive models.
Handling large datasets for accurate forecasting.

phase_breakdown.phase: Data pipeline and predictive model implementation
Dashboard integration and user acceptance testing

research_area.application_domain: Logistics, Warehousing, and Supply Chain Management

expected_outcomes: A scalable inventory management web application.
A predictive model capable of forecasting demand with a MAPE of less than 20%.
A comprehensive dashboard for visualizing stockouts and overstock risks.
limitations: Model struggles to predict demand for entirely new products (cold-start problem).
Forecast accuracy is highly susceptible to unprecedented external events (e.g., global pandemics).
Requires high-quality, consistent historical data to train models effectively.
future_scope: Integrate external data sources (weather, economic indicators) into the prediction models.
Develop a mobile application for warehouse workers to scan barcodes and update inventory on the floor.
Implement multi-echelon inventory optimization across a global supply network.
